8169044b5dfdfa8b016de9ace6703c3337be84e2.summary: Blackpoint Cyber reports that in November 2026 a legitimate business application used in the automotive industry was compromised through its software supply chain. Malicious JavaScript was inserted into the application's document rendering bundle, delivering a Node.js backdoor named IkonRAT that provides persistence and remote command execution. The report also describes recovered scripts for UAC bypass and exporting Windows registry hives, but says successful credential theft was not confirmed. The vendor removed the affected component.

81c9d894e544493159a57c858c0e9203fc405fab.summary: Check Point Research describes VoidLink, a modular Linux malware framework written in Zig and aimed at cloud and container environments. It has a web C2 dashboard, 37 plugins at the time of research, rootkit options, adaptive stealth, several C2 channels and anti-forensic modules. The developers are described as Chinese-affiliated, with exact affiliation unclear. The samples appear to be in-progress builds, and no real-world infections had been observed as of writing.

813f7820008c206bdcbaf4af6559ac0f0be9239b.summary: FortiGuard Labs describes EncystPHP, a PHP web shell delivered by exploiting CVE-2025-64328 in FreePBX Endpoint Manager v17.0.2.36 to v17.0.3. It drops further droppers, creates a root-level account, sets up cron persistence, and disguises itself as legitimate FreePBX files. The report says the activity appears associated with INJ3CTOR3, a group first identified in 2020. Incidents were launched in early December, and the exploit is said to have originated in Brazil and targeted a technology company in India.

81e2940328c14c5b89412bb6a133c50179880ef9.summary: Aqua's research team, Team Nautilus, describes the Autom cryptomining campaign, tracked for three years against its honeypots. Attackers exploited misconfigured Docker APIs, ran a vanilla alpine image with a malicious command to fetch the autom.sh script, created a privileged user for persistence, and disabled security features such as ufw. By 2021 they used repeated base64 encoding and a cron job to mine every 55 minutes. The report counts 84 attacks in total and 125 in Q3 2021, and notes that a fall in honeypot attacks did not mean the campaign slowed.
